design: Unified sound set: jump and land share one timbre (ui_pop/soft) at different pitches so jump->land reads as one action; gameover is a descending mallet phrase, not a single impact; highscore is an ascending mallet phrase in the same family.
earshot: Leonxlnx/earshot bank (MIT), rendered in code; no recorded audio, no models, no network for bank.render

sounds.role: act (jump / flap / switch / hook / shoot / pulse share this file today; see docs/audio-earshot.md)
land (same timbre as jump, one pitch lower, so jump->land is coherent)
fail (descending mallet phrase: it tells the player the run ended)
record (ascending mallet phrase, same family as gameover)
